## Day Prior to Surgery

- Clear liquids for dinner evening prior
- You will receive instructions regarding medicines
- Stop tube feeds at midnight night before

## Morning of Surgery

Unless instructed otherwise:

- You will be notified regarding *arrival* time, which is usually 2-3 hours before the *surgery* time.
  - Surgery Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday: Arrive 4am
  - Surgery Thursday: Arrive 5am
- Nothing to eat or drink after midnight

## Medicines the Morning of Surgery

- Medicines with a sip of water or *black* coffee
- No milk or cream
- Surgery will be cancelled for milk/cream

## Hospitality House

- Guest house for patients and families
- Located walking distance from hospital
- Shuttle service available
- Make reservation request through clinic nurses
- Cost $50 per night

## Parking and Arrival

- Blue Parking Deck: XXX Medical Center Drive, Charlotte ND 28204
- Enter Building through Dixon Tower (Traffic circle with Fountains)
- Check in at the desk and tell them you will have surgery
- Escort service will direct you to the Preoperative area on 5th floor


## Day of Surgery

- Waiting Room on 5th floor for families
- Surgery completed 3pm - 5pm
- Transfer to Surgical Intensive Care Unit 4pm - 6pm
- Visitors permitted into the ICU 5pm - 7pm

## Visitor's Policy

Intensive Care Unit

- Two visitors at a time 8am - 8pm
- One "Care Partner" can stay overnight in ICU

Ward

- All rooms are private rooms
- Day bed available for a family member
- Visiting hours 8am - 8pm

No visitors please who have a cough or fever!
